Definition: Whether credential is accepted or mandatory for registering for social assistance programs and accessing social services
Comments: The national ID is mandatory for accessing social services. Citizens without an NID are denied Social Assistance Grants for Empowerment (SAGE/senior citizens' grants), NSSF social security benefits, school capitation grants, and other welfare programmes. The High Court (June 2025) upheld the government's mandatory NID requirement for social services. CIPESA and civil society documented widespread exclusion of elderly and vulnerable people from SAGE due to lack of NID.
